name: Kedakaku Utsukushii Kokoro o Yogoshitai
original_name: 気高く美しい心を汚したい
source:
What awaits for the princess who lost the battle...

In the public environment, the defeated princess is thoroughly humiliated.

The princess who lost the battle with the imperial soldiers is sworn to be a toy at the mercy of her friend's life.
As many enemy soldiers watch, strip, open leg, urinate, insult ... and more.
The princess longed for by the people desperately endures the shame, but eventually her heart is broken...

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ081393.html]DLsite Maniax[/url]]
